name: audio_ren_update
doc: One AudioRenderSystem::Update (the game's RequestUpdateAudioRenderer) as the host takes it over (src/audio/ren.ts; nxnative h_ars_Update). At least one frame must be rendered between two updates (an effect's initialization lives for one update only). Pass: a frame was rendered since the last update, or this is the first. CatchUp: none was; a catch-up frame is rendered on this thread first, into the queue the render thread plays from. QueueFull / Waiting: the queue of four is full; the update waits for the render thread to play one (at most 50 ms), so that catch-up frames keep real time. Space: there is room now. StillFull: the output stopped; the frame is rendered and discarded. Sdk: the SDK's own Update runs.
